name: Maven CI + JavaDocs
on: push: pull_request: workflow_dispatch:
jobs: tests: runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps: - name: Check out repository uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Set up JDK 21 uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: temurin java-version: '21' cache: maven
- name: Make Maven wrapper executable run: chmod +x mvnw
- name: Run full test suite run: ./mvnw -B -ntp clean test
javadocs: runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: tests
steps: - name: Check out repository uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Set up JDK 21 uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: temurin java-version: '21' cache: maven
- name: Make Maven wrapper executable run: chmod +x mvnw
- name: Generate JavaDocs run: ./mvnw -B -ntp -DskipTests javadoc:javadoc
- name: Upload JavaDocs artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: javadocs path: target/site/apidocs if-no-files-found: error
